name: import_song
description: Convert a chord chart to canonical song2html source. Auto-detects ChordPro, inline [G]brackets, OpenSong XML, chords-over-lyrics, or song2html, keeps every chord in order, and reports diagnostics instead of guessing. Pass format when detection is ambiguous. Optionally transposes the result.

transpose.description: Half steps to transpose the key and named chords (Nashville numbers follow the key)

title.description: Title override for formats without metadata

key.description: Key override for formats without metadata, e.g. G, F#m, Bb

align.description: Chords-over-lyrics/OpenSong caret alignment: snap to words, or keep source columns

include.description: Extra result fields: Song AST, source-line mapping, format candidates

name: validate_song
description: Check song2html source and return diagnostics (errors must be fixed; warnings are advisory), song metadata, and arrangement names.

name: preview_song
description: Render song2html source as compact plain text with inline [Chord] markers, to verify caret placement without generating HTML.

name: render_html
description: Render song2html source to a standalone HTML page with embedded styles (or an HTML fragment).

arrangement.description: Arrangement to render (defaults to the first)

capo.description: Show chord shapes for a capo on this fret; overrides capo: metadata

fragment.description: Return only the <article> fragment instead of a full page
